title: CRUCIBLE Finding
description: One defect found in a manuscript. Every finding must be locatable and, if numeric, recomputable (Axiom 2).

severity.description: blocker = 投出去会被当场拒或撤稿级; major = 审稿人一定会写进 weakness; minor = 会扣印象分; nit = 可改可不改。

category.description: kebab-case defect type, e.g. numeric-contradiction, stale-value, unsupported-claim, missing-ablation, figure-illegible, hallucinated-citation.

summary_zh.description: 缺陷是什么、为什么是缺陷。中文叙述，引用的原文保持英文。

locations.description: Every place this defect manifests. First entry is the primary anchor.

role.description: For contradictions: which side of the contradiction this location is.

collector.description: Which bin/ script produced the underlying facts, or 'agent-read' when the finding is a judgment over prose that no script can produce.

recompute.description: REQUIRED for any numeric finding. The full arithmetic, showing what was computed, from what, and how it differs from what the paper prints. Axiom 2.

raw.description: Structured excerpt of the collector output this finding rests on.

evidence_dir_used.description: True when --evidence artifacts were consulted. Only then may a finding assert fabrication rather than mere inconsistency.

verdict.description: Set by crucible-verifier (Axiom 3). REFUTED findings are dropped from the report and retained only in findings.json for audit.

refutation_attempt.description: What the verifier tried in order to kill this finding, and why it survived (or didn't).

reviewer_impact_zh.description: 如果不改，审稿人会怎么写这条 weakness。用来判断值不值得花时间。

kind.description: mechanical = 唯一正确答案，agent 可直接应用; judgment = 涉及数字/主张/论证，产出补丁待批准; requires-experiment = 需要补跑实验; unfixable-before-deadline = 只能在 limitations 里认。

proposed.description: Replacement text or patch body. English, paste-ready.

patch_file.description: Path under crucible-out/patches/ when kind != mechanical.

depends_on.description: Finding ids that must be resolved first (e.g. a claim fix that depends on a numeric fix).
